whatIs: Motionin.design is a catalog of interactive, animated web sections, with physics and cursor effects, that you copy as a prompt and paste into an AI coding tool. Each section has a demo, and the filter lets you see the free and paid ones.
It's a good fit for giving a landing page a level of interaction that's hard to write by hand, without building it from scratch.
uses: Add an interactive hero section to an AI-generated landing page.
Check a section's demo before pasting its prompt into your editor.
Reuse animated sections in client work.
caveats: Only some sections are marked as free; the rest require a subscription or a one-time payment.
You need an AI coding tool, and the result depends on it: review the code and the performance of the animations.
The monthly plan unlocks only 3 sections per month, and they stay available for as long as the subscription lasts.
pricingNote: Some sections are free; the monthly plan costs $9 (3 sections per month), and there's a one-time payment whose price goes up as the library grows.
idealFor: Landing pages with eye-catching animations built with an AI assistant.
